# Loren Crain / bluehexagons

> Software engineer and indie game developer building games, web software, and infrastructure.

Primary site: https://bluehexagons.com/. GitHub Pages hosts a static copy.
Use the sources below for specific claims; client work is described only at a
public, high level.

## Pages

- [Games and projects](index.html): Games, creative tools, and browser demos.
- [Portfolio](portfolio.html): Work samples, technical details, and contribution credits.
- [Profile and resume](profile.html): Experience, skills, contact, and a printable resume.
- [Concise profile](profile.md): Generated from the same career records as the resume.
- [Antistatic](antistatic.html): Solo-developed platform fighter and technical guide.
- [Basaltwater](basaltwater.html): Linux setup, deployment, and development environments.
- [Open-source projects](index.html#open-source): Source code and browser demos.

## Credits

Loren Crain developed Antistatic solo. End of Blackjack’s music is by
[kikiala](https://kikiala.bandcamp.com/); Loren handled game development.
He was Air Dash Online’s sole programmer; teammates handled art and design.
The Don’t Starve Food Guide is almost entirely his work, with community contributions.

- [Website source](https://github.com/bluehexagons/bluehexagons) and [deployment manifest](https://github.com/bluehexagons/bluehexagons/blob/main/basaltwater.json).
- [Basaltwater source](https://github.com/bluehexagons/basaltwater): Implementation, tests, and documentation.

- [Coding environments](https://github.com/bluehexagons/basaltwater/blob/main/docs/agents/agentic-vms.md): Managed workspaces and browser verification.
